observations.supported_statement: InsideBusiness 中可处理实体 onboarding、填写资料及上传文件。新 KYC representative 的访问可由 Relationship Manager 安排。页面允许多名代表，但不同时操作。
observations.supported_statement_en: Entity onboarding, information and document submission; representative access is arranged through the RM. Multiple representatives do not imply simultaneous editing.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方页面；教程直链已发现，未播放核对

observations.supported_statement: 通过 Reference Number 与已登记联系方式的 OTP 进入更新流程；支持保存、续填和多联系人。建议从官网自行导航，沟通中不提供链接。部分个人信息受可见性限制。
observations.supported_statement_en: A reference number and OTP to registered contact details support specified Australian business KYC updates, with save/resume and contact visibility limits.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方页面；未登录服务

observations.supported_statement: 已有客户可用 HSBCnet 凭证，新客户可用 OTP；公开介绍动态表单、文件处理及进度。页面同时说明，获准代表某组织与特定 HSBC 实体沟通的用户可访问相应交换内容。
observations.supported_statement_en: SmartServe describes different existing/new-user entry paths and organisation-related communication access; per-item isolation is not established.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方页面；未进入已认证工作区

observations.supported_statement: 页面介绍可通过桌面或移动设备使用 SmartServe。
observations.supported_statement_en: Singapore SmartServe is described as available on desktop and mobile. Detailed Bermuda authentication settings cannot be transferred.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方页面

observations.supported_statement: 历史发布介绍 Portal、已有信息预填、电子文件交换与电子签名的 onboarding 方式。
observations.supported_statement_en: The 2019 APAC institutional release describes prefill, electronic exchange and signatures. Historical claims are not this project’s benefit estimates.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方发布

observations.supported_statement: 官方页面提供同名产品视频入口。
observations.supported_statement_en: An official onboarding video entry exists; its actual frames and timestamps have not been verified.
observations.verification_status: 官方视频落地页已发现；播放器/帧未核验

observations.supported_statement: 发布介绍客户关系统一视图、onboarding/servicing 及 KYC renewal 的改进，包括预填和避免重复填写。
observations.supported_statement_en: The 2025 commercial banking release describes relationship views and onboarding/servicing improvements. It is distinct from the 2019 institutional release.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方发布

observations.supported_statement: 页面介绍将 Cash、Loans、Trade、FX、Servicing 和 Onboarding 集合于同一平台的客户关系视图。
observations.supported_statement_en: A commercial banking platform video description mentions several product areas. Generic Cash/Trade screens are not KYC review evidence.
observations.verification_status: 已读取视频说明页；视频帧未核验

observations.supported_statement: 邮件或短信链接进入身份验证任务，无单独传统登录步骤；后续任务仍包含身份材料及相关验证。
observations.supported_statement_en: A narrow identity-verification task may start from email/text without a separate traditional login. This does not remove identity checks or grant case access.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方操作说明

observations.supported_statement: 注册后的合资格客户可通过银行渠道及 WhatsApp/WeChat 进行限定范围的 RM 沟通。官网提供注册与使用步骤图。
observations.supported_statement_en: Registered, eligible Hong Kong Premier customers have bounded RM communication channels. This is not Australian institutional KYC document collection.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方页面；4 个教程图片直链已发现，未下载

observations.supported_statement: 向适用企业扩展标准化 KYC 信息及文档共享，并保留数据拥有方对访问的控制。
observations.supported_statement_en: Standard KYC information exchange retains data-owner access control. Eligibility, connection and case-specific assessment are separate.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方发布

observations.supported_statement: 提供对应行尽调问卷及配套 guidance/glossary 等资源。
observations.supported_statement_en: Correspondent-banking questionnaires and guidance provide baseline patterns, not a ready-made corporate customer checklist.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方资源页；未审阅整个问卷文件

observations.supported_statement: Level 1 法人身份参考信息与 Level 2 直接/最终会计合并母公司关系是不同内容。
observations.supported_statement_en: Legal entity identity and accounting-consolidation parent relationships are distinct; parent data does not establish all natural-person beneficial owners.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方说明

observations.supported_statement: vLEI 的组织身份及角色凭证机制用于可验证的组织及代表关系。
observations.supported_statement_en: vLEI provides patterns for verifiable organisational roles. It does not grant this bank’s signing or trading authority.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方说明

observations.supported_statement: 说明 Common Domain Model 与可执行监管报告规则的关系，涉及标准化产品、事件与生命周期表达。
observations.supported_statement_en: ISDA event/state/rule expression is a modelling reference, not adoption of CDM or an official KYC schema.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方文档；未审阅完整标准

observations.supported_statement: 用重要事件里程碑组织协同并触发下游估计、告警和通知更新。
observations.supported_statement_en: A-CDM milestones can inform downstream updates. Aviation notification mechanisms are not bank approval or SLA rules.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方发布页；未逐图查看 PDF

observations.supported_statement: 以共享数据模型、API 和数据拥有者控制构建货运记录视图；官方页面链接模型可视化器与 demonstrator。
observations.supported_statement_en: ONE Record is a shared-data/access pattern in cargo; its model tools are not bank products.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方页面；可视化工具链接已发现，未运行

observations.supported_statement: 将可追溯性组织为 Critical Tracking Events 与描述事件实例的 Key Data Elements。
observations.supported_statement_en: GS1 traceability distinguishes events and key data elements; banking fields remain this project’s interpretation.
observations.verification_status: 官方搜索结果已核验；主站直接抓取受限

observations.supported_statement: 研究跨生命周期工程信息的连接、可追溯性和相关语义/可信交换。
observations.supported_statement_en: NIST digital-thread work informs version and change traceability; manufacturing rules are not transferred.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方项目页

observations.supported_statement: Provenance 记录针对资源的相关活动、目标、参与者和来源实体。
observations.supported_statement_en: FHIR R4 Provenance is a version-specific target/agent/source pattern, not implementation of a healthcare standard.
observations.verification_status: 已读取指定版本官方文档

observations.supported_statement: 指南修订讨论风险决策、主观性和质量风险管理方法。
observations.supported_statement_en: ICH Q9(R1) discusses risk decisions, subjectivity and quality risk-management methods in pharmaceuticals; banking QA mapping is not established.
observations.verification_status: 官方概要已核验；完整指南未逐项映射

observations.supported_statement: 提供 Pharmaceutical Quality System 的指导框架。
observations.supported_statement_en: ICH Q10 provides a pharmaceutical quality-system framework. Its summary does not prove a specific bank remediation process.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方概要页；完整指南未逐项映射

observations.supported_statement: 案件涉及业务电子通讯未被保存或监督，包括个人设备上的 WhatsApp 等非正式渠道。
observations.supported_statement_en: The 2023 SEC release concerns retention and supervision of business electronic communications by US broker-dealers; it is not a global WhatsApp ban.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方执法发布

observations.supported_statement: 区分邮箱确认与认证；其 out-of-band authentication 规则不接受电子邮件作为该认证方式。
observations.supported_statement_en: NIST distinguishes email confirmation from authentication; its out-of-band method does not accept email. A link and OTP to the same mailbox do not automatically constitute MFA.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方技术文档

observations.supported_statement: 上传处理涉及文件验证、权限、存储和恶意内容控制。
observations.supported_statement_en: Upload security guidance informs intake separation; receipt is not evidence sufficiency.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方技术资料

observations.supported_statement: 分别处理客户身份、代表者身份与权限、受益所有人及业务关系目的，并给出情境相关的信息/验证路径。
observations.supported_statement_en: AUSTRAC guidance distinguishes customer identity, representative identity and authority, beneficial owners and relationship purpose; specific obligations require contextual validation.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方 guidance

observations.supported_statement: 资金来源和财富来源是相关但不同的尽调问题。
observations.supported_statement_en: Source-of-funds/wealth guidance is a distinct due-diligence topic, not a universal document requirement derived from empty fields.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方 guidance

observations.supported_statement: 说明相应情境中的强化尽调工作与风险考虑。
observations.supported_statement_en: Enhanced due diligence depends on defined circumstances and targeted measures, not every screening alert.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方 guidance

observations.supported_statement: 指导交易对手信用风险管理，包括尽调、风险缓释、额度和治理。
observations.supported_statement_en: Counterparty credit-risk guidance supports treating Credit separately from KYC; local implementation and bank adoption are not established.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方发布页；未将完整指南配置成规则

observations.supported_statement: 提供澳大利亚相关名单与使用说明。
observations.supported_statement_en: The Australian consolidated-list page is a dynamic source reference, not every applicable list or synthetic identity evidence.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方说明；未提取真实命中放入演示

observations.supported_statement: 前轮研究支持：筛查 alert 需结合上下文评估，不能直接当作最终风险结论。
observations.supported_statement_en: Earlier research described contextual review of screening alerts. The 2019 PDF has not been reopened in this research round.
observations.verification_status: 本 session 前轮已研究；本轮未重新打开 PDF

observations.supported_statement: 将玻璃材质放在导航/控制层，并强调与内容层区分和可读性。
observations.supported_statement_en: Apple material guidance separates navigation/control from readable content; HTML blur is not native Liquid Glass optical refraction.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方视频文字与章节列表；未截视频帧。

observations.supported_statement: 模态窗口需管理内部键盘焦点、关闭及合理焦点恢复。
observations.supported_statement_en: Modal guidance calls for keyboard focus management and restoration; our implementation must still be tested.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方交互模式。

observations.supported_statement: 额外悬浮内容需满足适用的关闭、可悬停与持续显示要求。
observations.supported_statement_en: Hover/focus content must remain accessible and dismissible where applicable; critical blockers stay visible.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方解释。

observations.supported_statement: 拖动操作一般须有不要求拖动的单指针替代路径，特定例外另判。
observations.supported_statement_en: Dragging guidance supports non-drag alternatives such as stage and previous/next controls.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方解释。

observations.supported_statement: 推荐一致的Australian English拼写依据。
observations.supported_statement_en: Australian spelling guidance supports consistent language; locale switching cannot change business policy or jurisdiction.
observations.verification_status: 已读取官方写作说明。

observations.supported_statement: 筛查提示需要相关信息和上下文，复核理由需保留；行业 guidance，不是本行配置
observations.supported_statement_en: Screening alerts need context, relevant information and retained review rationale; guidance is not bank configuration.
observations.verification_status: Inherited limited research statement; Final performed no new website verification.

observations.supported_statement: 记录有不同名称/别名、身份属性、精度和未知；不是所有记录都有完整字段
observations.supported_statement_en: List records may contain aliases, multiple identity attributes, varying precision and unknowns.
observations.verification_status: Inherited limited research statement; Final performed no new website verification.

observations.supported_statement: guidance 讨论适用情境与针对性强化工作
observations.supported_statement_en: Guidance describes defined EDD circumstances and targeted enhanced work.
observations.verification_status: Inherited limited research statement; Final performed no new website verification.

observations.supported_statement: PEP 类别应与 sanctions/adverse media 区分，不以身份本身推导违法
observations.supported_statement_en: PEP status is distinct from sanctions or adverse media and does not itself imply unlawful activity.
observations.verification_status: Inherited limited research statement; Final performed no new website verification.

observations.supported_statement: 指定 R5 版本中描述 target/activity/agent/source 的追溯模式
observations.supported_statement_en: FHIR R5 Provenance relates a target to an activity, agent and source entities.
observations.verification_status: Inherited limited research statement; Final performed no new website verification.
